notes: PARKED — do not submit this manifest to a Scoop bucket yet. Two things must land first:
1. The agent has no named-pipe transport. `Transport::bind` returns Unsupported on
Windows, and the CLI reaches the agent for every command, so `bitting init` fails
at the transport layer. See docs/architecture.md.
2. No Windows artifact is published. release.yml builds x86_64-pc-windows-gnu as the
reproducibility reference target, but withholds it from the release for reason (1).
The URLs below therefore describe the intended shape and do not resolve today.
Bitting is distributed without a paid code-signing certificate. Installing through Scoop
avoids SmartScreen's browser-download reputation check, which is why this is the
recommended Windows channel once it works.
